drafts.subject: A note on your recent hiring at Acme AI
drafts.body:
Hi Acme AI team,

I noticed a few things recently: you're hiring a Knowledge Engineer to structure internal technical documentation, and you published an engineering post on retrieval quality problems in your internal RAG platform. I also saw that Engineering docs are maintained in Markdown in a public docs repository.

We're building LLM Wiki Agent — multi-agent system that transforms raw source material into role-specific interconnected knowledge pages. Teams use it to turn scattered Markdown, tickets and posts into role-specific, interconnected pages that stay current.

If keeping documentation useful across roles is on your radar, I'd be glad to show you a 15-minute walkthrough on your own repository. No pressure either way.

Best,
Wayne
